title: example 307 replay: its receipt records before's published-class match with Spring Security 5.2.0.M4 (review item 7)
description: The user's review item 7 of 2026-11-15 (llm-dlc/loops/example-targets.md, Progress): a source slice's receipt now records, in claim.target.matched, each class its preparation found byte-identical with a published JAR the sidecar names (preparation.slice.matches), taken from the preparation's source.slice.matched. Before this, 307's replay receipt showed only that both revisions are extracted-source slices; the check that before's BCrypt.class equals Spring Security 5.2.0.M4's published class was made by the preparation (which refuses a mismatch) but not recorded in the receipt. Step 1 reruns task replay of example 307 unchanged (build.py 307 --task replay: the source-slice route, each commit's BCrypt.java compiled with javac 8 -g -source 1.8 -target 1.8 -encoding UTF-8, the oracle on JDK 21 and 25, both slices expected to hold), adding a receipt beside the one kept. Step 2 reads the new receipt offline and exits 1 unless claim.target.matched lists exactly before's org/springframework/security/crypto/bcrypt/BCrypt.class, sha256 0b137406..., in spring-security-crypto 5.2.0.M4's JAR, sha256 8871c1fe..., and nothing for after (which has no published counterpart). No claim, expectation or verdict changes.
expected: Step 1 prints 'as expected' and exits 0: both slices hold the oracle on JDK 21 and 25; step 2 prints 'slice match recorded'
